segments.name: Smart electric vehicles
segments.description: Designs, assembles and sells smart electric passenger vehicles and auto parts and materials to customers, primarily in the UAE and China.
segments.evidence: The Group operates in a single operating segment and has one reportable segment, which includes all activities related to the sales of smart electric vehicles and auto parts and materials.

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue from customers who purchase its smart electric vehicles and auto parts and materials.
revenueModel.evidence: The Group operates in a single operating segment and has one reportable segment, which includes all activities related to the sales of smart electric vehicles and auto parts and materials.

changes.text: In 2024, the Company discontinued its Rabdan branded vehicle business after UAE authorities directed it to stop producing and selling Rabdan branded vehicles.
changes.evidence: In June 2024, the Company was notified by the same representative to refrain from selling any Rabdan branded vehicles within the UAE.

changes.text: In February 2026, subsequent to the 2025 fiscal year, the Company agreed to dispose of its entire equity interest in ICONIQ Holding Limited for nominal consideration.
changes.evidence: Subsequent to the reporting period, on February 5, 2026, the Company entered into a share transfer agreement with Energy Plus Management Limited, pursuant to which the Company agreed to dispose of its entire equity interest in ICONIQ Holding Limited, representing 100 % of the issued and outstanding shares of ICONIQ Holding Limited, for a nominal consideration of US$ 1.00 .
